name: neuron-anatomy backend (FastAPI/uvicorn) on EC2
description: Run the neuron-anatomy backend (samples/neuron-anatomy/backend) as a systemd unit on the existing trn2 host. Listens on port 8810; exposes /health and /neuron/* (topology, snapshot, SSE stream). Source tarball is fetched from a presigned S3 URL. Idempotent.

tasks.name: Precheck python3 + curl + tar + neuron-ls
tasks.description: Confirm the runtime tools we need are present. neuron-monitor / neuron-ls are required by the backend at request time.
commands: command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] python3 missing'; exit 1; }
command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] curl missing'; exit 1; }
command -v tar >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] tar missing'; exit 1; }
python3 -m venv --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[NG] python3-venv module missing; run: apt-get install python3-venv'; exit 1; }
test -x {{NEURON_LS_BIN}} || { echo '[NG] {{NEURON_LS_BIN}} missing — install aws-neuronx-tools'; exit 1; }
test -x {{NEURON_MONITOR_BIN}} || { echo '[NG] {{NEURON_MONITOR_BIN}} missing — install aws-neuronx-tools'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Download + extract neuron-anatomy backend tarball
tasks.description: Fetch the backend source via presigned S3 URL and extract under SERVE_DIR.
commands: test -n '{{SOURCE_TARBALL_URL}}' || { echo '[NG] SOURCE_TARBALL_URL is empty'; exit 1; }
test -f {{SERVE_DIR}}/backend/main.py || { echo '[NG] main.py missing after extract'; exit 1; }
test -d {{SERVE_DIR}}/backend/neuron_anatomy || { echo '[NG] neuron_anatomy/ missing after extract'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Create venv + pip install (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic)
tasks.description: Standalone venv for the anatomy backend so we never collide with the Neuron model server venvs (which carry torch/diffusers and are large).
commands: apt-get -y install python3-venv || { echo '[NG] apt-get install python3-venv failed'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Install neuron-anatomy.service systemd unit
tasks.description: Listens on 127.0.0.1:{{ANATOMY_PORT}} (the ALB target group reaches it via the EC2 security group ingress installed by NeuronAnatomyStack). Restart=always so the daemon survives a transient neuron-monitor failure.

tasks.name: daemon-reload + enable + start
tasks.description: systemctl daemon-reload, enable neuron-anatomy.service, and (re)start it.

tasks.name: Local HTTP health check on 127.0.0.1:{{ANATOMY_PORT}}/health and /neuron/topology
tasks.description: Wait up to 30s for /health to return 200, then verify that /neuron/topology returns at least one chip so neuron-ls is usable from the service user.
commands: if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "[OK] health http=$code (attempt=$i)"; break; fi

if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then echo '[NG] /health did not become 200 in 30s' >&2; systemctl status neuron-anatomy.service --no-pager || true; journalctl -u neuron-anatomy.service -n 80 --no-pager || true; exit 1; fi
chips=$(echo "$topo" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("neuron_device_count", 0))')
if [ "${chips:-0}" -lt 1 ]; then echo '[NG] /neuron/topology reported 0 chips' >&2; exit 1; fi
